title: Cs-Ba Epoch Profile Registry
what_it_does: A registry of five typed, SEPARATE candidate epoch transforms: CS133_FINE_PHASE (SI hyperfine 9192631770 Hz, fractional phase, wraps per cycle), CS137_DECAY_ENVELOPE (half-life 30.17 yr, remaining fraction 0.5 at one half-life), BA137_DAUGHTER_RATIO (daughter/parent accumulation, =1 at one parent half-life), BA130_PARENT_FULL (creation-scale, parent fraction ~1 on human scales), and COMPOSITE_VARIABLE_DEPTH. Isotope constants and source ontology are separate fields. Conventional UTC/TAI/TT/TDB timestamps stay mandatory in build_certificate even with a compressed epoch. compare_profiles reports all lanes side by side with selected=None.
negative_results: No isotope lane is pretended proven (EpochProfile.proven cannot be set True) and none is silently selected (refuse_lane_selected).
build_certificate refuses a missing conventional timestamp or a timescale outside UTC/TAI/TT/TDB.
Each lane is a candidate transform (OPERATOR_HYPOTHESIS / DERIVED_MATHEMATICS); the source epoch origin remains NOT_VALIDATED.

claims.statement: Four isotope epoch lanes plus a composite are implemented as distinct candidate transforms with their own constants, uncertainty, and claim class; none is discriminated or proven.

privacy_check: CLEAN - public isotope physical constants only; no private source narrative.
